description:
Lashnovo is a modern lash brand specializing in high-quality DIY cluster lashes and professional lash products. Our products are created for beauty lovers who want salon-quality results at home, as well as professionals who demand performance, ease, and consistency.
Each Lashnovo collection is designed with attention to quality, comfort, and aesthetics, offering looks ranging from natural elegance to bold, statement volume.

• What makes us different:

  • Salon-quality results at home

  • Fast and easy application, suitable for beginners and professionals

  • Multiple curated collections: natural, volume, length & luxury styles

  • Complete lash sets including bond, sealant, remover, and tools

  • High-end branding aligned with current beauty trends

  • Products designed for both consumers and professionals

Lashnovo bridges the gap between professional quality and everyday wearability.

• Lashnovo Ambassador Program (How ambassadors earn):

As a Lashnovo Ambassador, you earn 10% commission on every successful sale made through your personal ambassador link or code.

  • 10% commission per order

  • Personal tracking link & discount code

  • Transparent performance insights

  • Regular payouts

Our ambassadors represent the brand and are a key part of the Lashnovo community.

• How ambassadors can promote Lashnovo:

Lashnovo Ambassadors are encouraged to promote the brand across their platforms, including:

  • Instagram (posts, stories, reels)

  • TikTok (tutorials, reviews, before & after)

  • YouTube

  • Blogs or websites

  • Email marketing

High-performing ambassador content includes:

  • Lash tutorials & application guides

  • Before & after transformations

  • Unboxing content

  • Honest reviews and wear tests

  • “Get Ready With Me” content

✨ Ambassadors are allowed to publicly refer to themselves as “Lashnovo Ambassadors” in their bio, captions, and content if they choose.

• Ambassador welcome package:

After acceptance into the Lashnovo Ambassador Program, ambassadors will have the opportunity to work together with our customer service team to curate a personalized Lashnovo package.
This package is custom-selected based on your preferences and content style and will be sent completely free of charge, allowing you to experience and showcase the products authentically.

• Other information:

  • Ambassadors must be at least 18 years old

  • No misleading claims or false advertising

  • Content must align with Lashnovo’s brand values and visual identity

  • Lashnovo reserves the right to update or adjust the ambassador program

  • Violation of guidelines may result in removal from the program

We focus on long-term partnerships and building a strong community of ambassadors who genuinely love and represent Lashnovo 🤍
